text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're that same Trainer. I can say 
with confidence… that these lights have no 
signs of disappearing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
They amount to… almost 20 now. Well, it's 
not like they're bothering me or anything.

Only a small number of people can see the 
small lights revolving around Stay Gold. 
It seems that nothing strange has come 
from them.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, mind keeping me some company? There's 
a horsegirl in my year that is 
knowledgeable about the occult.
So the place we ended up was ——

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What the!? Stego, is there some kind of 
spirit possessing you!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oooh. You can see them, Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not at all! However, I shall attempt 
to do an exorcism from memory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Fungyaro Fungyaro～ Go back… from whence…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: you came!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Did it vanish!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Nope, still here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Huuuuh?

The instant exorcism had failed. Although 
there was no effect…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Huh? One of the lights has…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Vanished… Looks like you absorbed one of 
them…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ayaya? This… This scenery is…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what I see and what I feel… This 
scenery… It feels… like I've…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Become a Happy Max Daigongen!! It feels 
like the greatest fortune in my life has 
come!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …Hoh.

Seeing Matikanefukukitaru do a little 
dance, Stay Gold grinned and chuckled…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I think I get it. Although it's just a 
guess.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get going, Trainer. We got 
a "Restoration" journey to go on.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
OOOOOOOOH! Dunno what's going on but I'm 
feeling pumped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand it… I don't understand 
it, but I'm feeling frustrated…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
…Hm? I don't feel anything special. Was 
there supposed to be something Fabulous?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh… Pearl didn't absorb one of the lights…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case it has to be that. If 
there's certain horsegirls that the lights 
return to, then there are others that 
don't.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The lights have some type of homing 
instinct. You might not know what that is 
though.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Moving on, there's only 2 left now. An 
extra large pink one and an extra large 
green one.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let's return the extra large pink one 
first.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Stego… this is…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I knew the extra large pink one had to 
have been yours. Spe, how do you feel?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well, um! I feel really happy! But～…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This happiness… it's a bit much, I don't 
know how to phrase it. Um, for example～…
choice_data_list: Like you won a big race?
Like you ate a bunch of seafood?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Exactly like that feeling! When I won 
against strong horsegirls that I don't 
know!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Grass is there too… Ah, but she might 
not be there? I wonder which one it is…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's not sweat the small stuff. 
Anyways, the thing we came to return has 
been returned.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's good to savor that unique feeling. 
See ya.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. The amount of them decreased. A 
huge weight's been taken off my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? That's not the right 
feeling but…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah well, we can make it work! Certainly, 
it's like the happiness I feel when I eat 
a lot of delicious food!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, only Spe can perceive what she's 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's good to have your fill of it and 
savor it. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. The amount of them decreased. A 
huge weight's been taken off my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Render unto Caesar the things that are 
Caesar's" Finally, the last one ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This… extra large green one. If I can 
return it, I'd want to, but…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It might not go as smoothly this time. 
Let's take a break and advance carefully.
